desc:
Welcome to Sticks Incremental 2! 🌳 A Roblox Incremental/incremental simulator game packed with upgrades, progression, prestige layers, powerful sticks, automations, stats, and tons of content to unlock! ✨

How to play:
🪵 Collect Sticks and earn more Power!
⚡ Buy Upgrades and grow stronger!
🗺️ Unlock new exciting worlds!
🏷️ Roll and collect powerful titles!
🔥 Prestige to unlock insane upgrades and automations!
🏆 Discover better Sticks and climb to the top!

💎 Roblox Plus players get +20% Cash

👍 Drop a like and favourite the game for more updates!
